name: automated-reasoning-skills
description: Agent Skills for Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning checks: build an AR policy from a document, review its quality and fidelity, generate and run tests, debug failures via annotations, deploy it to a guardrail, and validate LLM answers at runtime with a rewrite loop.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test, deploy, and validate Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning policies.
interface.longDescription: Six focused skills covering the full Automated Reasoning lifecycle on Amazon Bedrock: turn a policy document into formal logic rules, review the quality and fidelity reports, generate scenarios and run Q&A tests, diagnose failures with the translate-vs-validate triage and repair via annotations, version and attach the policy to a guardrail, and validate LLM answers at runtime with an iterative rewrite loop.
defaultPrompt: Create an Automated Reasoning policy from this policy document.
Review my AR policy's quality and fidelity reports.
My AR test is failing — help me debug and fix the policy.
Validate this chatbot answer against my AR guardrail.
